name: hifi_amplicon_v1
description: PacBio HiFi MUC1 amplicons with both strands and per-read truth; pbsim3 + ccs error model (NOT calibrated to real HiFi data)

provenance.source: No real HiFi MUC1 amplicon data was available for calibration; only the strand mix is set. PCR artefacts and PCR length bias are left at defaults because they depend on the PCR protocol.
provenance.note: In MucOneUp 0.44.x audits pbsim3 ERRHMM-SEQUEL + ccs amplicon reads had ~0.7% median error (about Q21), noisier than typical HiFi (>= Q30). Calibrate pacbio_params (pass_num, min_rq) against your own data before drawing platform conclusions.
